moves.name: Standing Light Punch
moves.notes: In February 27, 2024 patch: hurtbox sizes increased on frames 2-8 but decreased on frames 9-11.

moves.name: Standing Heavy Kick
moves.notes: Limited Juggle State on anti-air hit and on Punish Counter (Knockdown +49)

moves.name: Crouching Heavy Punch
moves.notes: As of August 2026 patch: on-block from -6 to -4.

moves.name: Crouching Medium Kick
moves.notes: 20% damage scaling to followup combo hits.

moves.name: Crouching Heavy Kick
moves.notes: Limited Juggle Potential.

moves.name: Run > Forward + Punch (Backup)
moves.notes: Projectile invincibile once first hit lands, continuing into second hit. Second hit only comes out if the first connects. Second hit can canel into Supers as of May 2024 patch. As of December 2024 patch: 20% initial scaling.

moves.name: Run > Forward + Kick (Tempest Moon)
moves.notes: Air Current changes data, listed in brackets.

moves.name: Forward + Medium Punch (Flapping Spin)
moves.notes: Limited Juggle Potential on first hit, second hit forces air reset. Air Current makes Rashid fly far forward with this attack.

moves.name: Forward + Heavy Punch (Break Assault)
moves.notes: Air Current makes Rashid fly forward with this attack.

moves.name: Forward + Heavy Kick (Crescent Kick)
moves.notes: Hurtbox rises up from the bottom before active frames. Air Current makes Rashid fly forward with this attack. As of August 2026 patch: on-hit from +2 to +3.

moves.name: Run (Forward, Hold Forward)
moves.notes: Rashid's Forward Dash can be held to initiate Run and continue running, simply hold the second Forward input after pressing Forward > Forward to dash. Run can be cancelled by holding Back or Down-Back.Rashid's Forward Dash is 18 frames, but run doesn't activate until frame 20.

moves.name: Side Flip (Forward + KK)
moves.notes: Rashid will flip forward and can hop through standing opponents / over grounded opponents. 32 total frames.

moves.name: Front Flip (Side Flip > KK)
moves.notes: Rashid will Jump after the side flip. Can control range with Back+KK (shortest), KK (middle), or Forward+KK (farthest), this direction obeys Rashid's original starting position, so if he crosses the opponent up the Front Flip direction affect distance as they would have before he crossed them up. Can perform any Jump attack out of the Front Flip.

moves.name: Medium Punch, Heavy Kick (Rising Kick)
moves.notes: Limited Juggle State on hit.

moves.name: Wall Jump
moves.notes: Can wall jump by jumping into a wall/the edge of the screen, then presing press Up+Away from the wall/edge of screen.

moves.name: Jump Medium Punch
moves.notes: Limited Juggle State on air hit.

moves.name: Jump Heavy Punch
moves.notes: First hit is Limited Juggle State on air hit, but second hit forces knockdown on air hit.

moves.name: Jump Medium Kick
moves.notes: Crosses up.

moves.name: Forward Jump, Down + Heavy Punch (Blitz Strike)
moves.notes: Jumps off the opponent's head on hit or on block, which then allows Rashid to perform any Jump attack after. The in-game frame meter's hit/block data assumes Rashid empty lands, so on-hit, he's actually incredibly advantaged in terms of when he can act. So much so that, in the corner where he doesn't travel away due to hitting the wall, on-hit he can combo Blitz Strike into every jumping attack from even the earliest Blitz Strike hit. On-block in the corner, he's around -9...-12. Forced knockdown on air hit.

moves.name: Neutral Jump, Up + Heavy Kick (Aerial Shot)
moves.notes: Limited Juggle State on air hit.

moves.name: Spinning Mixer (Light Punch)
moves.notes: Whiff has 5 frames longer recovery. Air Current makes Rashid fly far forward with this attack, data in bracket.

moves.name: Spinning Mixer (Medium Punch)
moves.notes: Anti-air invincible on frames 6-14. Air Current makes Rashid fly far forward with this attack, data in bracket. Crouch block causes last hit to whiff, resulting in another -4 advantage. March 2026 patch: adjusted anti-air invincible frames to 6-14 and adjusted hurtbox (normal version only). August 2026 patch: Air curren version is now anti-air invincible on frames 3-17.

moves.name: Spinning Mixer (Heavy Punch)
moves.notes: Anti-air invincible on frames 5-11. Air Current makes Rashid fly more upward with this attack, data in bracket.

moves.name: Spinning Mixer (Overdrive)
moves.notes: Fully invincible on frames 1-8[1-6]. Air Current makes Rashid fly more upward with this attack, data in bracket. Air Current version can cancel into Arabian Skyhigh on hit. In February 27, 2024 patch: anti-air invincibility added to third hit's active frames. As of December 2024 patch: knockdown on hit changed from +22[+47] to +9[+42].

moves.name: Eagle Spike (Light Kick)
moves.notes: Air Current makes Rashid fly far forward with this attack, data in bracket. Forced 55 frame Block animation prevents any potential for variable meaty on-block advantage. Can cancel into Level 3 Super after landing on the ground (on hit only, as of the May 2024 patch).

moves.name: Eagle Spike (Medium Kick)
moves.notes: Air Current makes Rashid fly far forward with this attack, data in bracket. Forced 55 frame Block animation prevents any potential for variable meaty on-block advantage.

moves.name: Eagle Spike (Heavy Kick)
moves.notes: Air Current makes Rashid fly far forward with this attack, data in bracket. Forced 55 frame Block animation prevents any potential for variable meaty on-block advantage.

moves.name: Eagle Spike (Overdrive)
moves.notes: Air Current makes Rashid fly far forward with this attack, data in bracket. Forced 55 frame Block animation prevents any potential for variable meaty on-block advantage.

moves.name: Whirlwind Shot
moves.notes: Cannot be used during Ysaar (Level 2 Super). Can hold to charge a second and third projectile, based on hold length. Kick strength changes the trajectory: Heavy Kick is the shortest, then Medium Kick is farther, then Light Kick farther again, then Overdrive is the farthest and does not rise. Overdrive can only charge one level, data is in brackets. Fully charged Whirlwind Shot creates an Air Current on the ground at Rashid's position for 1 second. As of March 2026 patch: held OD version can now be cancelled into WingStroke/Rolling Assault at frame 54.

moves.name: Arabian Cyclone (Heavy Punch)
moves.notes: Limited Juggle State on hit.

moves.name: Arabian Cyclone (Overdrive)
moves.notes: Limited Juggle State on hit. Creates an Air Current on the ground at Rashid's position for 1 second.

moves.name: Wing Stroke
moves.notes: Considered a jump/can use any jump attack from frame 31 onward. 67 frames total if no jump attack is used.

moves.name: Rolling Assault
moves.notes: Upper Body projectile invincible on frames 5-30.

moves.name: Nail Assault
moves.notes: Upper Body invincible on frames 1-19. Limited Juggle State on hit.

moves.name: Arabian Skyhigh (Light Kick)
moves.notes: Leg projectile invincibility on frames 1-21. Limited Juggle State on hit. Can use jump attacks afterward.

moves.name: Arabian Skyhigh (Medium Kick)
moves.notes: Leg projectile invincibility on frames 1-26. Limited Juggle State on hit. Can use jump attacks afterward.

moves.name: Arabian Skyhigh (Heavy Kick)
moves.notes: Leg projectile invincibility on frames 1-29. Limited Juggle State on hit. Can use jump attacks afterward.

moves.name: Arabian Skyhigh (Heavy Kick)
moves.notes: Leg projectile invincibility on frames 1-21. Limited Juggle State on hit, but transitions into a forced dive kick followup.

moves.name: Super Rashid Kick (Level 1)
moves.notes: Strike/throw invincible on frames 1-15. Breaks armor. Grounded (early) hit does 2100, late (anti-air or juggle) hit does 1800.  As of December 2024 patch: knockdown +11 to +1 on grounded hits.

moves.name: Ysaar (Level 2)
moves.notes: Breaks armor. Spawns a slow moving tornado that moves across the screen, an Air Current travels just behind the tornado while active. Limited Juggle State on hit. Counts as a Super projectile, so regular and Overdrive projectiles get eaten by it.

moves.name: Altair (Level 3)
moves.notes: Fully invincible on frames 1-15. Breaks armor. Critical Art in parenthesis.
